housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 832 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Brescia city centre; this source does not support a deposit norm or a main local rental portal.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that online account opening requires a valid identity card, driving licence or passport plus an Italian tax code or valid health card.
required_docs: Valid identity card, driving licence or passport
Italian tax code or valid health card

schools.summary: The Brescia international-schools directory lists International Baccalaureate programmes, including PYP, MYP and DP offerings.

legal_admin.summary: New arrivals must promptly declare residence to the Comune di Brescia registry; first registrations from abroad use the municipal declaration form and supporting documents.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit a residence declaration to the Comune di Brescia registry, with identity, occupancy and applicable immigration-status documents.

tax_finance.summary: Foreign citizens obtain the Italian codice fiscale through the immigration desk, police headquarters or Revenue Agency depending on their situation; first-time applicants must attend an in-person identity check.

transport.summary: Brescia Mobilità publishes a EUR 39 monthly pass for Zone 1 or Zone 2 of Brescia public transport; driving-licence exchange and healthcare registration remain unsupported in this single-source object.
